title: Teessoo Battala Keessatti Imalte
intro: Namni aangoo guddaa qabu tokko mootummaa sooressaa badhaadhummaa hamma hin jedhamneen eebbifame irratti bulchaa ture. Bulchaan kun qormaanni hin eegamne yommuu kaʼu, qormaanni billaa utuu hin taʼin ogummaa fi amantiin isa mudate. Wanti mul’ate olka’iinsa humna addunyaa irraa gara jijjiirama garaa gadi fagootti nama geessa.
clues: Mootummaa badhaadhina fi badhaadhina yaaduu ol ta'een eebbifame irrattin bulchaa ture
Ani mootii humna guddaa qabuu fi xalayaan ija jabinaan akka dhiyaadhu gaafatu naaf dhufe ture
Mootii fagoo kana wajjin wal loluu moo nagaa buusu ilaalchisee abbootiin koo na gorsan
Ofii kootii mootii fagoo kanaan wal arguuf kennaa ajaa'ibaa qabadheen ka'e
Teessoon mootii koo ija jaamsuu keessatti, osoon hin deebi'in gara biyya fagootti fidame
Masaraa lafti akka geejjibaa sirri ta’e tokko yommuu seenu, dhumarratti Rabbiif gadi bu’uu koo labse

trial.label: Yaali/Taatee
options: Xalayaa jajjaboo akka dhiyaatan gaafatu argachuu
Ummata tokko lolaadhaan akka balleessu dhugaa ba'uu
trial.answer: Xalayaa jajjaboo akka dhiyaatan gaafatu argachuu

location.label: Qaama Ijoo
options: Teessoo mootii dinqisiisaa warqee fi dhagaa gati jabeessa irraa hojjetame
location.answer: Teessoo mootii dinqisiisaa warqee fi dhagaa gati jabeessa irraa hojjetame

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Osoo diina ari'uu galaana keessatti liqimfamuu
Iddoo biqiltuu gammachuu bara baraa keessaa baqachuu

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
